rv.q: The links between Jim Steinman’s numbers and the action often seem a bit tenuous. Yet the strangeness of Scheib and Bausor’s vision makes it hard to avoid being swept up in this raunchy spectacle, where the principals intermittently shed their punky/glam rock costumes as they cavort about the stage in lusty pursuit of each other.
A Leggers review Jim Steinman’s Bat Out of Hell The Musical at the Dominion Theatre in London’s West End. Will it be Break A Leg? It!
